B0-71
BODY SUDING ROOF
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE ROOF HEADLINING
(See page B0--88)
2. REMOVE SLIDING ROOF GLASS
(a) Remove the 4 screws.
(b) Pull the glass upward to remove it.
3. REMOVE DRIVE GEAR
NOTICE:
Remove the drive gear with the sliding roof fully closed.
(a) Remove the 2 screws and room light bracket.
(b) Disconnect the connector.
(c} Remove the 2 bolts and drive gear.
Torque: 5.4 N,m (55 kgf.cm, 48 ft-lbf)
4. REMOVE SLIDING ROOF HOUSING
{a) Disconnect the 4 drain hoses from the housing.
(b) Remove the 12 bolts and 6 brackets.
Torque: 5.4 N-m (55 kgf-cm, 48 ft-lbf)
(c) Remove the 4 nuts, then remove the housing.
Torque: 5.4 N,m {55 kgf.cm, 48 ft,lbf)
